title: Judge verdict (verdict@1)
description: One DECIDED verdict for one item: what decide() / decideVerdict() return, never what a judge returns. A judge returns only {item, criteria, abstain, abstainReason}; score, outcome and calibrated are derived by code. Cross-field rules the schema states only in part (score is the MINIMUM criterion score; outcome pass iff every criterion passes and score >= threshold) are checked by judge_contract.validate().

item.description: The id of the item judged. Empty only on an abstain whose report named no item.

rubric.description: <plugin>-<name>@<int>; the criteria are listed in that plugin's references.

decidedBy.description: command when an exit code, parser, test or probe produced the criteria; judge when one model call did.

criteria.description: One entry per rubric criterion, in rubric order. Empty exactly when the verdict abstained.

abstainReason.description: A fixed code when code abstained (verdict-missing, missing-item, item-mismatch, malformed:abstain, malformed:criteria, malformed-criterion:<i>, duplicate-criterion:<id>, unknown-criterion:<id>, bad-score:<id>, bad-pass:<id>, bad-evidence:<id>, missing-criterion:<id>), or judge:<text> when the judge abstained itself. Null when the verdict did not abstain.

score.description: The MINIMUM criterion score, never an average. 0 on an abstain.

outcome.description: An abstain is never a pass: a caller that gates on outcome treats it as not passed.

calibrated.description: True only when the rubric's calibration record shows a sealed known-answer set whose agreement cleared its floor.
